an4.193:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Vesāliyaṃ viharati Mahāvane Kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
an4.193:1.2: Atha kho Bhaddiyo Licchavi yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Bhaddiyo Licchavi Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca :
an4.193:2.2: māyāvi samaṇo Gotamo āvaṭṭaniṃ māyaṃ jānāti yāya aññatitthiyānaṃ sāvake āvaṭṭetīti.
an4.193:2.4: māyāvī samaṇo Gotamo āvaṭṭaniṃ māyaṃ jānāti yāya aññatitthiyānam sāvake āvaṭṭetīti--kacci te bhante Bhagavato vuttavādino na ca Bhagavantaṃ abhūtena abbhācikkhanti dhammassa cānudhammaṃ vyākaronti na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānupāto gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgacchati, anabbhakkhātukāmā hi mayaṃ bhante Bhagavantan ti. 2.
an4.193:3.1: Etha tumhe Bhaddiya mā anussavena mā paramparāya mā itikirāya mā piṭakasampadānena mā takkahetu mā nayahetu mā ākāraparivitakkena mā diṭṭhinijjhānakkhantiyā mā bhavyarūpatāya mā samaṇo no garūti.
an4.193:3.2: Yadā tumhe Bhaddiya attanā va jāneyyātha--ime
an4.193:3.3: dhammā akusalā ime dhammā sāvajjā ime dhammā viññugarahitā ime dhammā samattā samādinnā ahitāya dukkhāya saṃvattantīti --atha tumhe Bhaddiya pajaheyyātha. 3.
an4.193:4.2: purisassa ajjhattaṃ uppajjamāno uppajjati hitāya vā ahitāya vāti?
an4.193:4.4: Luddho panāyaṃ Bhaddiya purisapuggalo lobhena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto pāṇam pi hanti adinnam pi ādiyati paradāram pi gacchati musā pi bhaṇati param pi tathattāya samādapeti yaṃ sa hoti dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya ti.
an4.193:5.2: doso purisassa . . . pe . . . moho purisassa . . . pe . . . sārambho purisassa ajjhattaṃ uppajjamāno uppajjati hitāya vā ahitāya vāti?
an4.193:5.4: Sāraddho panāyaṃ Bhaddiya purisapuggalo sārambhena abhibhūto . . . dukkhāyāti.
an4.193:6.1: Taṃ kiṃ maññatha Bhaddiya--ime dhammā kusalā vā akusalā vāti?
an4.193:6.7: Samattā samādinnā ahitāya dukkhāya saṃvattanti no vā
an4.193:6.9: Samattā bhante samādinnā ahitāya dukkhāya saṃvattanti,
an4.193:7.1: Iti kho Bhaddiya yaṃ taṃ avocumha:
an4.193:7.2: etha tumhe Bhaddiya mā anussavena mā paramparāya ma itikirāya mā piṭakasampadānena mā takkahetu mā ākāraparivitakkena mā diṭṭhinijjhānakkhantiyā mā bhavyarūpatāya mā samaṇo no garūti.
an4.193:7.3: Yadā tumhe Bhaddiya attanā va jāneyyātha--ime
an4.193:7.4: dhammā akusalā ime dhammā sāvajjā ime dhammā viññugarahitā ime dhammā samattā samādinnā ahitāya dukkhāya saṃvattantīti--atha tumhe Bhaddiya pajaheyyāthāti--iti
an4.193:7.5: yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ idam etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ. 7.
an4.193:8.1: Etha tumhe Bhaddiya mā anussavena mā paramparāya . . . pe . . . garūti.
an4.193:8.2: Yadā tumhe Bhaddiya attanā vā jāneyyātha--ime
an4.193:8.3: dhammā kusalā ime dhamma anavajjā ime dhammā viññuppasatthā ime dhammā samattā samādinnā hitāya sukhāya saṃvattantīti--atha tumhe Bhaddiya upasampajja vihareyyātha. 8.
an4.193:9.2: purisassa ajjhattaṃ uppajjamāno uppajjati hitāya vā ahitāya vāti?
an4.193:9.4: Aluddho panāyaṃ Bhaddiya purisapuggalo lobhena anabhibhūto apariyādinnacitto n' eva pāṇaṃ hanti na adinnaṃ ādiyati na paradāraṃ gacchati na musā bhaṇati param pi tathattāya na samādapeti yaṃ sa hoti dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyāti?
an4.193:10.1: Taṃ kiṃ maññatha Bhaddiya--adoso purisassa . . . pe . . . amoho purisassa [ . . . pe] . . . asārambho purisassa ajjhattaṃ uppajjamāno uppajjati hitāya vā ahitāya vati?
an4.193:10.3: Asāraddho panāyaṃ purisapuggalo asārambhena anabhibhūto apariyādinnacitto n' eva pāṇaṃ hanti na adinnaṃ ādiyati . . . hitāya sukhāyāti.
an4.193:11.1: Taṃ kiṃ maññatha Bhaddiya--ime dhammā kusalā vā akusalā vāti?
an4.193:11.7: Samattā samādinnā hitāya sukhāya saṃvattanti no vā
an4.193:11.9: Samattā bhante samādinnā hitāya sukhāya saṃvattanti
an4.193:12.1: Iti kho Bhaddiya yaṃ taṃ avocumha:
an4.193:12.2: etha tumhe Bhaddiya mā anussavena mā paramparāya mā itikirāya mā piṭakasampadānena mā takkahetu mā nayahetu ākāraparivitakkena mā diṭṭhinijjhānakkhantiyā mā bhavyarūpatāya mā samaṇo no garūti.
an4.193:12.3: Yadā tumhe Bhaddiya attanā va jāneyyātha--ime
an4.193:12.4: dhammā kusalā ime dhammā anavajjā ime dhammā viññuppasatthā ime dhammā samattā samādinnā hitāya sukhāya saṃvattantīti--atha tumhe Bhaddiya upasampajja vihareyyāthāti--iti
an4.193:12.5: yaṃ taṃvuttaṃ idam etaṃ paṭicca vuttam. 12.
an4.193:13.1: Ye kho te Bhaddiya loke santo sappurisā te sāvakaṃ evaṃ samādapenti:
an4.193:13.2: Ehi tvaṃ ambho purisa lobhaṃ vineyya viharāhi
an4.193:13.3: lobhaṃ vineyya viharanto na lobhajaṃ kammaṃ karissasi kāyena vācāya manasā,
an4.193:13.5: dosaṃ vineyya viharanto na dosajaṃ kammaṃ karissasi kāyena vācāya manasā,
an4.193:13.7: mohaṃ vineyya viharanto na mohajaṃ kammaṃ karissasi kāyena vācāya manasā,
an4.193:13.9: sārambhaṃ vineyya viharanto na sārambhajaṃ kammaṃ karissasi kāyena vācāya manasāti. 13.
an4.193:14.1: Evaṃ vutte Bhaddiyo Licchavi Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca :
an4.193:14.2: Abhikkantaṃ bhante . . . pe . . . Upāsakaṃ maṃ bhante Bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃgatan ti.
an4.193:15.1: Api nu tāhaṃ Bhaddiya evaṃ avacam:
an4.193:15.2: ehi me tvaṃ Bhaddiya sāvako hohi,
an4.193:15.5: Evaṃ-vādiṃ kho maṃ Bhaddiya evam-akkhāyiṃ eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā asatā tucchā musā abhūtena abbhācikkhanti:
an4.193:15.6: māyāvī samaṇo Gotamo āvaṭṭaniṃ māyaṃ jānāti yāya . . . āvaṭṭetīti.
an4.193:15.9: Piyā me bhante ñātisalohitā imāya āvaṭṭanīyā āvaṭṭeyyuṃ piyānam pi me assa ñātisalohitānaṃ dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya.
an4.193:15.10: Sabbe ce pi bhante khattiyā imāya āvaṭṭanīyā āvaṭṭeyyuṃ sabbesam p' assa khattiyānaṃ dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya.
an4.193:15.11: Sabbe ce pi bhante brāhmaṇā . . . vessā . . . suddā imāya āvaṭṭaniyā āvaṭṭeyyuṃ sabbesam p' assa suddānaṃ dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyātī.
an4.193:16.1: Evam etaṃ Bhaddiya evam etaṃ Bhaddiya.
an4.193:16.2: Sabbe ce pi Bhaddiya khattiyā [imāya āvaṭṭaniyā] āvatteyyuṃ akusaladhammappahānāya kusaladhammūpasampadāya sabbesam p' assa khattiyānaṃ dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya.
an4.193:16.3: Sabbe ce pi Bhaddiya brāhmaṇā vessā suddā . . . āvaṭṭeyyuṃ akusaladhammappahānaya kusaladhammūpasampadāya sabbesam p' assa suddānaṃ dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyāti.
an4.193:16.4: Sadevako ce pi Bhaddiya loko samārako sabrahmako sassamaṇabrāhmaṇi pajā sadevamanussā . . . āvaṭṭeyyuṃ akusaladhammappahānāya kusaladhammūpasampadāya sadevakassa lokassa samārakassa sabrahmakassa sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya.
an4.193:16.5: Ime ce pi Bhaddiya mahāsālā . . . āvaṭṭeyyuṃ akusaladhammappahānāya kusaladhammūpasampadāya imesaṃ p' assa mahāsālānaṃ dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya. Sace ceteyyuṃ
